$showcase.indexIntro: Every graph in this section is one of **{total} golden layouts** produced by the ELK Java reference implementation (the oracle, built from source). They are stored as ELK JSON and rendered **live in your browser** from that JSON. One page per layout algorithm:
$showcase.indexOutro: Each card shows the oracle layout, a short description, and, folded away, the ELK JSON it is drawn from. These are the layouts the TypeScript port is held to (see {conformance}).
$showcase.algorithmIntro: Each graph below is an oracle layout rendered live in your browser from its ELK JSON.

blurbs.layered: Layer-based (Sugiyama-style) layout for node-link diagrams with ports and hierarchy.

ptolemy-scrambler: The smallest hierarchical Ptolemy model: one composite with ports and node labels (12 nodes, 22 ports, 11 labels, depth 2), laid out with default layered settings and the default seed.
ptolemy-clockdrift-hierarchy: Two levels of nested children with hierarchical edges (12 nodes, 31 ports, 11 labels, depth 3), laid out with default layered settings and the default seed.
ptolemy-afdx-multicast: Multicast fan-out edges across composite ports with fixed port sides and indices (15 nodes, 30 ports, 14 labels, depth 2).
ptolemy-crossbar-switch: A port-dense model, about three ports per node, that stresses port ordering (13 nodes, 40 ports, 12 labels, depth 2).
